{"target_smiles":"CCCCCCCCCNC(=O)c1cc(Oc2c(Cl)cc(N)cc2Cl)ccc1O","routes":[{"strategy_plan":"本路线采用汇聚式策略高效构建多取代水杨酰胺目标分子。逆合成分析首先将目标分子的酰胺键切断，拆分为正壬胺与5-(4-氨基-2,6-二氯苯氧基)-2-羟基苯甲酸，拟通过经典的缩合试剂介导酰胺化完成最终组装。酸前体中的苯胺官能团可由对应的硝基芳烃经温和的选择性催化还原得到。核心二芳基醚骨架的构建利用2,5-二羟基苯甲酸甲酯与1,2,3-三氯-5-硝基苯之间的芳香亲核取代（SNAr）反应完成：由于水杨酸酯的2位酚羟基与邻位羰基存在强分子内氢键作用，其亲核性显著低于5位酚羟基，从而保证了高化学与区域选择性的酚醚化反应。醚化产物经皂化水解释放羧酸后即可依次完成硝基还原与酰胺缩合。所有起始原料分子量均小于12个重原子，来源商业易得。","key_disconnection_class":"Amide coupling","disconnection_type":"coupling","planned_num_steps":4,"strategy":"基于SNAr构建二芳醚的水杨酰胺合成","route_id":1,"steps":[{"step_id":1,"product":"CCCCCCCCCNC(=O)c1cc(Oc2c(Cl)cc(N)cc2Cl)ccc1O","precursors":["CCCCCCCCN","Nc1cc(Cl)c(Oc2ccc(O)c(C(=O)O)c2)c(Cl)c1"],"reaction_class":"Amide coupling"},{"step_id":2,"product":"Nc1cc(Cl)c(Oc2ccc(O)c(C(=O)O)c2)c(Cl)c1","precursors":["O=C(O)c1cc(Oc2c(Cl)cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc2Cl)ccc1O"],"reaction_class":"Nitro reduction"},{"step_id":3,"product":"O=C(O)c1cc(Oc2c(Cl)cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc2Cl)ccc1O","precursors":["COC(=O)c1cc(Oc2c(Cl)cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc2Cl)ccc1O"],"reaction_class":"Ester hydrolysis"},{"step_id":4,"product":"COC(=O)c1cc(Oc2c(Cl)cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc2Cl)ccc1O","precursors":["COC(=O)c1cc(O)ccc1O","O=[N+]([O-])c1cc(Cl)c(Cl)c(Cl)c1"],"reaction_class":"SNAr etherification"}],"starting_materials":["CCCCCCCCN","COC(=O)c1cc(O)ccc1O","O=[N+]([O-])c1cc(Cl)c(Cl)c(Cl)c1"]}]}

{"target_smiles":"CCCCCCCCCNC(=O)c1cc(Oc2c(Cl)cc(N)cc2Cl)ccc1O","routes":[{"strategy_plan":"本路线针对目标水杨酰胺衍生物的结构特点，采取汇聚式的逆合成策略。首先将目标分子中的苯胺氨基逆推为稳定的芳香硝基前体，最后一案通过温和的硝基还原获得目标产物，有效避免了游离苯胺基团在前期可能引发的化学选择性干扰。水杨酰胺侧链由5-(2,6-二氯-4-硝基苯氧基)-2-羟基苯甲酸与正壬胺通过酰胺缩合构建。二芳基醚核心骨架的构筑则通过芳香亲核取代反应实现：利用2,5-二羟基苯甲酸甲酯与1,2,3-三氯-5-硝基苯在碱性条件下进行SNAr醚化，龙胆酸甲酯的5位酚羟基具有更高的亲核活性，能高度选择性地进攻硝基对位的高活性氯原子。随后经酯水解即可释放出羧酸。起始原料均为廉价易得的基础化学品，路线高效且选择性可控。","key_disconnection_class":"Nitro reduction","disconnection_type":"fgi","planned_num_steps":5,"strategy":"SNAr醚化与后期酰胺化及硝基还原策略","route_id":1,"steps":[{"step_id":1,"product":"CCCCCCCCCNC(=O)c1cc(Oc2c(Cl)cc(N)cc2Cl)ccc1O","precursors":["CCCCCCCCCNC(=O)c1cc(Oc2c(Cl)cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc2Cl)ccc1O"],"reaction_class":"Nitro reduction"},{"step_id":2,"product":"CCCCCCCCCNC(=O)c1cc(Oc2c(Cl)cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc2Cl)ccc1O","precursors":["O=C(O)c1cc(Oc2c(Cl)cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc2Cl)ccc1O","CCCCCCCCCN"],"reaction_class":"Amide coupling"},{"step_id":3,"product":"O=C(O)c1cc(Oc2c(Cl)cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc2Cl)ccc1O","precursors":["COC(=O)c1cc(Oc2c(Cl)cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc2Cl)ccc1O"],"reaction_class":"Ester hydrolysis"},{"step_id":4,"product":"COC(=O)c1cc(Oc2c(Cl)cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc2Cl)ccc1O","precursors":["COC(=O)c1cc(O)ccc1O","O=[N+]([O-])c1cc(Cl)c(Cl)c(Cl)c1"],"reaction_class":"Nucleophilic aromatic substitution"},{"step_id":5,"product":"COC(=O)c1cc(O)ccc1O","precursors":["O=C(O)c1cc(O)ccc1O","CO"],"reaction_class":"Fischer esterification"}],"starting_materials":["CCCCCCCCCN","CO","O=C(O)c1cc(O)ccc1O","O=[N+]([O-])c1cc(Cl)c(Cl)c(Cl)c1"]}]}

{"target_smiles":"N#Cc1ccc(Oc2ccc3c(c2)CCN(C2CCC2)CC3)cn1","routes":[{"strategy_plan":"本路线采用汇聚式合成策略制备目标分子。首先，核心骨架中的芳基醚键通过亲核芳香取代反应（SNAr）构建，由5-氟-2-氰基吡啶与6-羟基-2-环丁基-1,2,3,4-四氢异喹啉直接偶联形成。四氢异喹啉片段中环丁基侧链的引入则通过四氢异喹啉酚与环丁酮的还原胺化高效实现。四氢异喹啉母核的构建采用经典的Pictet-Spengler反应，由廉价易得的4-甲氧基苯乙胺与甲醛在酸催化下缩合环合得到6-甲氧基-1,2,3,4-四氢异喹啉，随后利用三溴化硼脱除甲基保护基得到酚羟基前体。该路线步骤紧凑、收率高、反应条件温和，所有起始物料均为廉价市售化学品。","key_disconnection_class":"Nucleophilic aromatic substitution","disconnection_type":"coupling","planned_num_steps":4,"strategy":"SNAr醚化连接吡啶与四氢异喹啉核心","route_id":1,"steps":[{"step_id":1,"product":"N#Cc1ccc(Oc2ccc3c(c2)CCN(C2CCC2)CC3)cn1","precursors":["N#Cc1ccc(F)cn1","Oc1ccc2c(c1)CCN(C1CCC1)CC2"],"reaction_class":"Nucleophilic aromatic substitution"},{"step_id":2,"product":"Oc1ccc2c(c1)CCN(C1CCC1)CC2","precursors":["Oc1ccc2c(c1)CCNCC2","O=C1CCC1"],"reaction_class":"Reductive amination"},{"step_id":3,"product":"Oc1ccc2c(c1)CCNCC2","precursors":["COc1ccc2c(c1)CCNCC2"],"reaction_class":"Demethylation"},{"step_id":4,"product":"COc1ccc2c(c1)CCNCC2","precursors":["COc1ccc(CCN)cc1","C=O"],"reaction_class":"Pictet-Spengler reaction"}],"starting_materials":["C=O","COc1ccc(CCN)cc1","N#Cc1ccc(F)cn1","O=C1CCC1"]}]}

{"target_smiles":"CC(C)(C(=O)C(F)(F)F)C(c1ccccc1)c1ccc2c(cnn2-c2ccc(F)cc2)c1","routes":[{"strategy_plan":"本逆合成路线首先将目标分子断开三氟甲基酮α位的全碳季碳与次甲基碳碳键，或者考虑将芳基直接引入到共轭受体中。更优的切断策略是将包含双芳基取代的碳骨架通过1,4-共轭加成反应构建：切断目标分子中C(芳基)-C(季碳)键，得到三氟甲基取代的α,β-不饱和烯酮与有机金属试剂（或有机硼试剂）的加成前体；或更直接地，将目标分子直接断开为1-(4-氟苯基)-1H-吲唑-5-甲醛衍生物与α-三氟乙酰基异丁酸酯同系物的偶联产物。在此选择更具收敛性的亲核加成/烷基化策略：以1-(4-氟苯基)-1H-吲唑-5-甲醛与苄基膦酸酯发生Horner-Wadsworth-Emmons反应构建二芳基乙烯基骨架，随后通过自由基加成或共轭加成引入2-三氟乙酰基异丙基片段。吲唑骨架则可通过5-溴-1H-吲唑与4-氟苯硼酸发生Chan-Lam偶联或芳基化构建。所有反应均可追溯至易得的商品化简单芳香砌块。","key_disconnection_class":"Conjugate addition","disconnection_type":"coupling","planned_num_steps":5,"strategy":"共轭加成引入季碳并结合吲唑N-芳基化策略","route_id":1,"steps":[{"step_id":1,"product":"CC(C)(C(=O)C(F)(F)F)C(c1ccccc1)c1ccc2c(cnn2-c2ccc(F)cc2)c1","precursors":["Fc1ccc(-n2ncc3cc(/C=C/c4ccccc4)ccc32)cc1","CC(C)(I)C(=O)C(F)(F)F"],"reaction_class":"Conjugate addition"},{"step_id":2,"product":"Fc1ccc(-n2ncc3cc(/C=C/c4ccccc4)ccc32)cc1","precursors":["O=Cc1ccc2c(cnn2-c2ccc(F)cc2)c1","CCOP(=O)(Cc1ccccc1)OCC"],"reaction_class":"Horner-Wadsworth-Emmons reaction"},{"step_id":3,"product":"O=Cc1ccc2c(cnn2-c2ccc(F)cc2)c1","precursors":["OB(O)c1ccc(F)cc1","O=Cc1ccc2[nH]ncc2c1"],"reaction_class":"Chan-Lam coupling"},{"step_id":4,"product":"CC(C)(I)C(=O)C(F)(F)F","precursors":["CC(C)C(=O)C(F)(F)F","II"],"reaction_class":"Alpha-iodination"},{"step_id":5,"product":"CCOP(=O)(Cc1ccccc1)OCC","precursors":["BrCc1ccccc1","CCOP(OCC)OCC"],"reaction_class":"Michaelis-Arbuzov reaction"}],"starting_materials":["BrCc1ccccc1","CC(C)C(=O)C(F)(F)F","CCOP(OCC)OCC","II","O=Cc1ccc2[nH]ncc2c1","OB(O)c1ccc(F)cc1"]}]}

{"target_smiles":"CC(C)(C(=O)C(F)(F)F)C(c1ccccc1)c1ccc2c(cnn2-c2ccc(F)cc2)c1","routes":[{"strategy_plan":"本逆合成路线首先切断目标分子中三氟甲基酮α位季碳中心与二芳基甲基之间的碳-碳单键。这一关键切断将复杂分子简化为1,1,1-三氟-3-甲基丁-2-酮与二芳基溴代甲烷两个主要片段。合成难点在于位阻较大的全碳季碳中心的构建以及N1-芳基取代吲唑的选择性组装。二芳基溴化物可由对应的仲醇经Appel反应制备，仲醇则通过苯基格氏试剂进攻5-甲酰基吲唑中间体获得。5-甲酰基吲唑可由5-溴吲唑经锂卤交换甲酰化制备，吲唑骨架则通过商业可得的5-溴-2-甲基苯胺发生亚硝化重氮化及分子内Jacobson环合构建，随后经Chan-Lam偶联引入对氟苯基。全路线原料廉价易得，步骤简洁高效。","key_disconnection_class":"Enolate alkylation","disconnection_type":"coupling","planned_num_steps":6,"strategy":"酮烯醇化物烷基化偶联构筑季碳中心","route_id":1,"steps":[{"step_id":1,"product":"CC(C)(C(=O)C(F)(F)F)C(c1ccccc1)c1ccc2c(cnn2-c2ccc(F)cc2)c1","precursors":["CC(C)C(=O)C(F)(F)F","Fc1ccc(-n2ncc3cc(C(Br)c4ccccc4)ccc32)cc1"],"reaction_class":"Enolate alkylation"},{"step_id":2,"product":"Fc1ccc(-n2ncc3cc(C(Br)c4ccccc4)ccc32)cc1","precursors":["OC(c1ccccc1)c1ccc2c(cnn2-c2ccc(F)cc2)c1"],"reaction_class":"Appel reaction"},{"step_id":3,"product":"OC(c1ccccc1)c1ccc2c(cnn2-c2ccc(F)cc2)c1","precursors":["O=Cc1ccc2c(cnn2-c2ccc(F)cc2)c1","[Br][Mg][c]1ccccc1"],"reaction_class":"Grignard reaction"},{"step_id":4,"product":"O=Cc1ccc2c(cnn2-c2ccc(F)cc2)c1","precursors":["Fc1ccc(-n2ncc3cc(Br)ccc32)cc1","CN(C)C=O"],"reaction_class":"Bouveault aldehyde synthesis"},{"step_id":5,"product":"Fc1ccc(-n2ncc3cc(Br)ccc32)cc1","precursors":["Brc1ccc2[nH]ncc2c1","OB(O)c1ccc(F)cc1"],"reaction_class":"Chan-Lam coupling"},{"step_id":6,"product":"Brc1ccc2[nH]ncc2c1","precursors":["Cc1ccc(Br)cc1N"],"reaction_class":"Jacobson indazole synthesis"}],"starting_materials":["CC(C)C(=O)C(F)(F)F","CN(C)C=O","Cc1ccc(Br)cc1N","OB(O)c1ccc(F)cc1","[Br][Mg][c]1ccccc1"]}]}

{"target_smiles":"CC(C)(C(=O)C(F)(F)F)C(c1ccccc1)c1ccc2c(cnn2-c2ccc(F)cc2)c1","routes":[{"strategy_plan":"本路线针对目标分子中的三氟甲基酮和季碳-次甲基骨架进行逆合成切断。首先，三氟甲基酮单元可通过三甲基(三氟甲基)硅烷（Ruppert-Prakash试剂）对前体甲酯进行亲核三氟甲基化高效构筑。对于含相邻全碳季碳与次甲基的酯基骨架，考虑通过路易斯酸催化的Mukaiyama型烷基化反应，由异丁酸甲酯衍生的二甲基硅烯醇缩醛与二芳基甲醇中间体直接缩合构建C-C键。二芳基甲醇中间体则通过苯基格氏试剂对1-(4-氟苯基)-1H-吲唑-5-甲醛进行亲核加成得到。吲唑-5-甲醛母核上的芳基则利用Chan-Lam铜催化偶联反应，以商业可得的1H-吲唑-5-甲醛与4-氟苯硼酸偶联引入。全路线原料廉价易得，步骤高度汇聚。","key_disconnection_class":"Ruppert-Prakash trifluoromethylation","disconnection_type":"coupling","planned_num_steps":6,"strategy":"Mukaiyama烷基化与三氟甲基化策略构建目标酮","route_id":1,"steps":[{"step_id":1,"product":"CC(C)(C(=O)C(F)(F)F)C(c1ccccc1)c1ccc2c(cnn2-c2ccc(F)cc2)c1","precursors":["COC(=O)C(C)(C)C(c1ccccc1)c1ccc2c(cnn2-c2ccc(F)cc2)c1","C[Si](C)(C)C(F)(F)F"],"reaction_class":"Ruppert-Prakash trifluoromethylation"},{"step_id":2,"product":"COC(=O)C(C)(C)C(c1ccccc1)c1ccc2c(cnn2-c2ccc(F)cc2)c1","precursors":["OC(c1ccccc1)c1ccc2c(cnn2-c2ccc(F)cc2)c1","COC(O[Si](C)(C)C)=C(C)C"],"reaction_class":"Mukaiyama alkylation"},{"step_id":3,"product":"COC(O[Si](C)(C)C)=C(C)C","precursors":["COC(=O)C(C)C","C[Si](C)(C)Cl"],"reaction_class":"Silyl enol ether formation"},{"step_id":4,"product":"OC(c1ccccc1)c1ccc2c(cnn2-c2ccc(F)cc2)c1","precursors":["O=Cc1ccc2c(cnn2-c2ccc(F)cc2)c1","[Br][Mg][c]1ccccc1"],"reaction_class":"Grignard addition"},{"step_id":5,"product":"[Br][Mg][c]1ccccc1","precursors":["Brc1ccccc1","[Mg]"],"reaction_class":"Grignard reagent formation"},{"step_id":6,"product":"O=Cc1ccc2c(cnn2-c2ccc(F)cc2)c1","precursors":["O=Cc1ccc2[nH]ncc2c1","OB(O)c1ccc(F)cc1"],"reaction_class":"Chan-Lam coupling"}],"starting_materials":["Brc1ccccc1","COC(=O)C(C)C","C[Si](C)(C)C(F)(F)F","C[Si](C)(C)Cl","O=Cc1ccc2[nH]ncc2c1","OB(O)c1ccc(F)cc1","[Mg]"]}]}
